body:
# ![ABOUT HEADING](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1aac8905bf30ae278a0b40f3f0fd69d1365e5ad1.png)

This is a simple mod, created purely as a test of Geckolib's first-person arm rendering. I liked the model and wanted to share it and make more in the same style, for the fun of it i guess.

## ![features heading](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d04ca66745ac4bbf0c2ba63c365e602ac6353245.png)

The mod contains two items. The "MinecraftPhone" and the "Hotel Bell." You can right-click the "MinecraftPhone" to put on a comedy show, and you can right-click the Hotel Bell to attract all animal and monster type mobs (eg, Zombie, Pig, etc). The mod has one key binding. You may press "Y" ( by default ) to inspect the item / play an animation. All items also have a pullout and use animation.
